metric: unweighted mean of within-participant balanced accuracies
CI: paired participant percentile 95%; equal weights; 2.5th/97.5th quantiles; no multiplicity adjustment
scope: Supplement to the sealed phase2/phase3 evaluations, using only completed saved predictions; existing phase2 results already known when this supplement was specified
interpretation_limits: Four exploratory comparisons (two model pairs, two tasks); 95% intervals are not multiplicity adjusted
Existing 17-person heldout is reused; not an independent confirmatory evaluation
Phase3 SSL-to-MI and phase2 scratch use the same supervised batch256, epochs60 and updates1500; the encoder initialization path differs
Fused fits use different batch sizes and numbers of optimizer updates under fixed resource budgets; any difference cannot be attributed solely to extra EEG or SSL
No refitting, threshold tuning, model selection, new EEG/model forward, or change to the sealed evaluation is allowed by this analysis
Differences describe cue-response task decoding, not unrestricted intent or autonomous real-world action
